# Label and explanation rows

Model: `labelled-rows`. Each call creates a complete slide. Inter, geometry and text sizes are fixed.

[Model index](../../../templates/MODELS.md) · [Palette and content guide](../../STUDIO-MODELS.md)

```latex
\studiosetup{palette=light}
\studiotemplate[variant=default]{labelled-rows}
```

Palette switches are available only where the original composition exists in both colours.
Unsupported explicit choices fail. A global palette leaves special compositions in their native treatment.

## Variants and named fields

### default

Original palettes: light.

[Current source](../../../templates/studio/labelled-rows.tex) · [Full slot guide](../guides/labelled-rows.md)

| Field | Default | Available space |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | <code>Slide\\title</code> | 33.9% wide × 15.6% high |
| `item-one/label` | <code>First label</code> | 13.3% wide × 4.1% high |
| `item-one/body` | <code>First supporting explanation</code> | 22.6% wide × 3.2% high |
| `item-two/label` | <code>Second label</code> | 13.3% wide × 4.1% high |
| `item-two/body` | <code>Second supporting explanation</code> | 22.6% wide × 6.2% high |
| `item-three/label` | <code>Third label</code> | 13.3% wide × 4.1% high |
| `item-three/body` | <code>Third supporting explanation</code> | 22.6% wide × 6.2% high |

Omitted fields retain these descriptive defaults; empty values retain their allocated space. Numbers and charts are illustrative.

## Complete one-slide example

```latex
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{beamer}
\usetheme{bitpolito-studio}
\usepackage{bitpolitostudiotemplates}
\usepackage[backend=biber]{biblatex}
\addbibresource{bibliography.bib}
\begin{document}
\studiotemplate[
  variant={default},
  palette={light},
  title={Slide\\title},
  item-one={
    label={First label},
    body={First supporting explanation}
  },
  item-two={
    label={Second label},
    body={Second supporting explanation}
  },
  item-three={
    label={Third label},
    body={Third supporting explanation}
  }
]{labelled-rows}
\end{document}
```
